The plate is about 400 px across in the image. If it is a dinner plate of roughly 26 cm, that gives about 0.065 cm per px.

The omelet is folded and measures about 100 px wide by 240 px long. That is roughly 6.5 cm by 15.6 cm. Its thickness is probably 2-3 cm because it is folded.

A rough volume is 6.5 × 15 × 2.5, which is about 240 cm³. Omelets are fluffy, so I'll assume a density near 0.9 g/cm³. That gives about 200 g, which seems high, so I'll lower it to about 150 g, roughly a 3-egg omelet.

Cooked omelet is about 150-190 kcal per 100 g once cooking oil is included. At 150 g that comes to about 250 kcal.

```json
{"kcal": 250, "mass_g": 150}
```
